description: Deterministic rule hierarchy for selecting domain, language, framework and vulnerability review guidance.

rules.title: Web service entry-point review
rules.purpose: Treat routes and request inputs as candidate attack entry points.

rules.title: Infrastructure boundary review
rules.purpose: Review provider, deployment and trust-boundary assumptions before IaC use.

rules.title: TypeScript source-flow review
rules.purpose: Apply TypeScript import, async, serialization and runtime-boundary heuristics.

rules.title: Python source-flow review
rules.purpose: Apply Python request, serialization and process-boundary heuristics.

rules.title: Express route and middleware review
rules.purpose: Trace middleware, route parameters and authorization checks across Express handlers.

rules.title: Access-control and privilege review
rules.purpose: Look for missing, misplaced or confused identity, tenant and privilege checks.

rules.title: Input-to-sink data-flow review
rules.purpose: Trace user-controlled data through sanitizers and dangerous execution or storage sinks.

rules.title: Dependency and supply-chain review
rules.purpose: Correlate dependency signals with SBOM and threat-intelligence context.
